description_en: Activates log delivery for a flow log
kebab_example: aliyun expressconnectrouter activate-flow-log --ecr-id ecr-mezk2idmsd0vx20000 --dry-run true --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-000000 --flow-log-id flowlog-m5evbtbpt0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ActivateFlowLog

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Express Connect Router (ECR) instance
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: Performs a dry run to check the request. The system does not activate log delivery.

false (default): Sends the request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique token on your client for each request. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the flow log instance
parameters.name: flow_log_id

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial

Code.description_en: The status code. A return value of 200 indicates that the call is successful. For more information about other return values, see the error codes
Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为200表示加载成功，返回其他值表示加载失败，失败原因参见错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message. This message is used to replace the `%s` placeholder in the ErrMessage parameter.

For example, if the ErrMessage parameter returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and the DynamicMessage parameter returns DtsJobId, it means the value of the DtsJobId parameter is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。

如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则表示所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of EcrId **** is illegal.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

True: The call was successful.

False: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：

True：成功。
False：失败
